name: Shockwave
description: A diagonal shockwave breaks the first clip into falling glass tiles with a chromatic split and neon edge glow. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tile_size
params.description: Size of each tile, relative to the frame height

params.name: scatter
params.description: How far the tiles slide and fall

params.name: prism
params.description: Red/blue separation at the moving edges

params.name: glow
params.description: Brightness of the colored tile edges
